explanation: Compared against Written on the Wall II (archived all.html and the definitions file wowIIdefs.js from cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/, via the Wayback Machine; the live site does not respond), Conjecture 18 (status T; 'Feb. 21, 2006 Benny John generalized Schindl's proof of 17 to prove #18'): 'If G is a simple connected graph, then b(G) ≥ α(G) + CEIL(sqrt(dist_max(M)))', where M is the set of vertices of maximum degree and dist_max(M) = maximum{dist_G(u,v) | u and v are in M}. Lean: for connected G on a finite nontrivial type, (indepNum G : ℝ) + ⌈√(distMaxSet G M)⌉ ≤ b G with M = {v | degree v = maxDegree} and distMaxSet the maximum of G.dist over all pairs in M (0 if M is a single vertex), exactly the source definition. b G is the largest size of a vertex set inducing a bipartite subgraph. Direct transcription; faithful.
